name: Aoi Norio
source:
The protagonist of the hidden "Aomushi Shou" scenario. A third year student at Midoriyama Academy High School, he has excellent grades. He's in the same class as [url=/c140351]Tobisawa Youhei[/url]. He always carries a digital camera with him and uses it for nefarious purposes, such as extorting others with their secrets.
He's a professional manga artist with the pen name "Sunayume Neko" and has a serialized series in the adult magazine "DoEro H2".
